title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Company Description** 




**International Research Institute for Manufacturing (IRIM** 
 ) is a global research, management consulting, and training firm specializing in the manufacturing sector. Known for its gold\-standard competitiveness and green manufacturing rating models, IRIM supports over 500 leading Indian organizations annually in enhancing manufacturing processes. The organization focuses on areas such as manufacturing and supply chain performance, sustainability, green manufacturing strategies, advanced research, and benchmarking. IRIM’s framework emphasizes connecting manufacturing competitiveness with business performance to deliver measurable results.
 



  





**Role Description** 



* This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role based in Chennai.
* Research and identify potential clients through online platforms and databases
* Reach out to prospects via calls, emails, and social media
* Build and maintain strong client relationships
* Maintain accurate client and sales records using CRM tools
* Collaborate with internal teams to achieve sales targets and organizational goals



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum of 7\.5 CGPA in UG with no history of arrears
* Strong analytical and market research skills
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Professional fluency in English and Hindi (Good to Have)
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with CRM tools are a plus
* Willingness to learn, take ownership, and work in a target\-driven environment



 A basic understanding of the manufacturing industry is an added advantage
 



  





**Why Join IRIM:** 



* Ideal opportunity for freshers to start a B2B Research sales and consulting career
* Exposure to leading manufacturing organizations across India
* Exposure to consulting, research, and benchmarking initiatives
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to be part of the largest industry program for the manufacturing sector

title: Strategic Sales Executive
description:
We are seeking a driven, self\-motivated candidate to join our growing organization. In this position, you will be pivotal in understanding the needs of authors who publish with us and providing effective solutions. This role requires high energy, strong interpersonal skills, a keen awareness of current trends, and a customer\-focused approach.
 



  





 Supported by a strategy\-led, values\-based approach and disciplined execution, working here means being inspired, connected, developed, and rewarded.
 



  





**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:** 



* Manage relationships with authors, ensuring they feel supported post\-publication.
* Guide authors in their marketing and promotional efforts, ensuring strategies are aligned with their goals.
* Monitor marketing campaign effectiveness and book sales, providing authors with insightful feedback and actionable steps for improvement.
* Act as the primary point of contact for any author concerns, addressing them promptly and efficiently.
* Foster long\-term relationships with authors, encouraging continuous engagement with Notion Press services.



  





 Requirements
 



  




* 0\-1 year of experience in any industry. Customer\-facing experience is a bonus.
* The enthusiasm to interact with a lot of interesting people on a daily basis.
* Strong Communication skills with strong command over the English language. A second language is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business/Marketing/ Literature, or a related field.
* The ability to find solutions quickly and desire to grow with a confident and determined approach.
* Highly self\-motivated and ambitious in achieving goals.
* Should possess the skill to work both in a team and also perform independently.
* Should be capable of thriving in competitive markets.
* Last but not least; must have a competitive streak.



  





 Benefits
 



 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as:
 


* A flat and transparent culture and a chance to work with the leadership team of a high\-growth startup
* Best learning and development opportunities, a chance to have a big impact in a hyper\-growth setup
* The possibility of having a huge societal impact \- we help writers fulfil their dreams and our books reach hundreds of thousands of readers across the world
* Other Benefits \- Employee Stock Options, Paid Time Off for Annual Vacations and Healthcare Insurance



  





**Diversity and Inclusion:** 
 Notion Press is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. As of January 2021, we have achieved our ‘Gender diversity' goals. Women comprise fifty percent of our workforce.
